claims.object_text: encodes the cytosolic protein SYNGAP1 (SYNaptic GTPase Activating Protein), an essential component of the postsynaptic density at excitatory glutamatergic neurons
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 is a gene that encodes the cytosolic protein SYNGAP1 (SYNaptic GTPase Activating Protein), an essential component of the postsynaptic density at excitatory glutamatergic neurons.

claims.object_text: plays critical roles in synaptic development, structure, function, and plasticity
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 plays critical roles in synaptic development, structure, function, and plasticity.
Mutations in SYNGAP1 result in a neurodevelopmental disorder termed Mental retardation-type 5 (MRD5, OMIM #612621)
